prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent animated dog walk sprite sheet. Inputs 1-3 are the original photographs of ONE particular beloved small cinnamon-orange and white long-haired dog. Input4 is the existing game rear-view sheet; use its upper-left rear idle dog's appearance, NOT the differing camera angles elsewhere. Preserve that same dog, warm tan back, silky long fur, small upright fluffy ears, white socks, cream-white feathered tail curled onto the back. Create ONE landscape sheet, exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, EIGHT equally sized cells in strict row-major animation order. Each cell contains the SAME complete dog viewed DIRECTLY FROM BEHIND, walking AWAY from a FIXED camera looking down slightly at about 15 degrees, like a three-lane endless runner. This is a single cyclic natural brisk WALK, not eight separate action poses. Frame0 left hind paw contact forward/right hind lifts;1 left stance/right swing midpoint;2 left stance/right paw forward;3 double support transition;4 right hind contact/left lifts;5 right stance/left swing midpoint;6 right stance/left forward;7 double support naturally returning to0. Forelegs alternate naturally visible slightly either side. Small realistic shoulder/hip motion, tail sway limited and continuous; the paws visibly articulate and step. EVERY cell must retain exactly the same rear camera, body width, fur volume, scale, rear head silhouette, lighting and centerline. Never turn sideways, never look back, never jump, never change breed. Model animation-sheet quality with smooth evenly spaced motion, minimal body bob, distinct paws. Natural detailed photoreal fur matching the references, not a toy render. Each dog centered at 50% cell width; fixed common imaginary floor at 88% cell height; standing body including ears fits 12%-88% cell height, same standing height in all eight cells, generous clear transparent margins around all ears/paws/tail. Genuine alpha transparency surrounding each silhouette, including cell gutters. No ground, no cast shadow, no text, labels, numbers, grid lines, collar, leash, scenery, bone or watermark. No cropped limbs. All eight cells required. Prioritize consistent anatomy and framing for seamless loop over adding extra drama.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent game dog facial expressions and gestures sheet. Image1 is the existing accepted front sprite sheet; use its UPPER LEFT standing dog as exact visual identity reference. Images2-4 are photos of that same dog, keep its face, narrow white forehead blaze, small brown-pink nose, glossy dark round eyes, small upright triangular furry ears, long cinnamon-orange cheek fur, long flowing white chest bib, natural white-sock paws. Create ONE landscape sheet with exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, EIGHT equal uniform cells, one complete dog each in this exact row-major order:0 neutral happy standing, mouth open tongue small;1 same stance with eyes half closed mid blink;2 same stance both eyes fully gently closed blink;3 same standing stance modest head tilt to its left;4 same standing stance modest head tilt to its right;5 same frontal dog raises ONE forepaw slightly in friendly greeting with head centered, other paws in place;6 same stance soft pleased smile, tongue resting just within open mouth;7 same stance delighted happy expression tongue out, ears perked. These are controlled variants of ONE dog, not different dogs. Keep body posture, fur volume, camera, eye spacing, scale, paws and curled cream feathered tail identical except the specified localized action. Front-facing fixed camera at the dog's chest height. Detailed softly photorealistic fur exactly matching accepted game art, no cartoons or plastic stylization. Dog centered at 50% each cell width, feet on common imaginary floor at 88% cell height, ears top at about12%. Generous transparent gutter. Entire ears, all paws and tail fit every cell. Genuine alpha transparent background, no floor, no shadows, no props, collar, clothing, text, numbers, labels, borders, gridlines, logo or watermark. Same warm neutral lighting in every frame. Exact consistent eye and muzzle proportions and recognizable resemblance matter more than exaggerated expression. No extra bodies or duplicate faces.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent authored game animation posture sheet with twelve sequentially usable dog poses. Image1 is the freshly accepted expression sheet: its FIRST upper-left standing dog is the exact character to preserve. Images2-4 are original photographs of this same beloved dog including its lying and seated appearances. Create ONE sheet exactly FOUR columns by THREE rows, TWELVE equally sized cells, no labels. Same exact small cinnamon-orange and white long-haired dog, identical face/eyes/brown-pink nose/white forehead blaze/white long chest bib/white sock paws, cream plumed tail. Soft detailed photorealistic fur matching Image1. Fixed FRONT camera looking at dog at chest height; do NOT change to side or overhead. Common dog size and groundline in EVERY cell: imaginary paw floor at88% cell height, body center x50%; standing ears at about15%, sitting ears LOWER naturally, lying ears MUCH LOWER naturally; NEVER enlarge a sitting or lying dog to fill cell height. Same width and lighting throughout. Provide these EXACT row-major poses: row1 cell0 neutral cheerful STANDING on four feet, matching expression sheet cell0; cell1 haunches halfway lowering toward sit with forelegs upright; cell2 nearly seated haunches low with forelegs upright; cell3 fully SITTING upright with hindquarters grounded and front paws side by side. row2 cell4 same seated pose eyes gently closed blink; cell5 same seated pose one forepaw raised a little as greeting; cell6 seated dog beginning to lower front elbows toward lying, chest intermediate height; cell7 halfway lying, elbows bent chest about half the seated height. row3 cell8 fully LYING sphinx-style on belly, front paws extended symmetrically, head upright and happy eyes open; cell9 SAME lying pose eyes half closed; cell10 SAME lying pose eyes fully closed peacefully; cell11 SAME lying pose lowers head to rest on front paws like reference photo1. Anatomically distinct proper sitting/lying with intermediate poses, not squash/stretch of a standing body. Paws stay at consistent floor level and centerline throughout transition. Small true differences between intermediate frames make natural reversible stand-to-sit and sit-to-lie animation. Every complete dog, all ears/paws/tail fit inside its own cell with generous transparent margins, no overlapping into neighbors. Genuine alpha transparent background. No floor, rug, blanket, cast shadow, props, text, numbers, gridlines, border, collar, leash, clothing or watermark. No extra limbs, no cropped paws, no breed or face changes. Consistent recognizable character and real animal posture are the priority.
